lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five distinct horizontal rows extending posteriorly from the branchial region across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows to form a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from light-intensity upper margins to shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-contrast spot distribution across the visible surface of the left pectoral fin, transitioning from small, tightly packed nodes at the leading edge to larger clusters proximally.
